text:
Situation: Sterile water for injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-11-23 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 2.4 to 10.6 days of supply, with the lowest at Corvale East (10 mL SDV at 2.4 days and 5 mL SDV at 2.7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2021-11-23. Inspection and enforcement history for listed manufacturers includes: Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) OAI inspection ending 2019-09-06 and Warning Letter issued 2020-03-25; Nephron SC, LLC (FEI 3010892830) Warning Letter issued 2020-09-22 and OAI inspection ending 2022-04-20; Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) VAI inspection ending 2019-11-21.

Our position: Supply is critically low at multiple sites. American Regent, Inc. is not on FDA's shortage list today and its plant last received a VAI inspection on 2024-04-24, making it the preferred source. Additional qualified suppliers not on the shortage list include Novo Nordisk, Sandoz Inc., Becton Dickinson and Company, and Biocon Biologics Inc.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate orders with American Regent, Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and order from Novo Nordisk as secondary source — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and order from Sandoz Inc. as tertiary source — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Becton Dickinson and Company and Biocon Biologics Inc. for formulary addition — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further FDA updates; relying solely on current allocation from shortage-listed manufacturers.
